name: Waveshare SX1302 LoRaWAN Gateway HAT
comment: Different pins from every other SX1302 HAT this catalogue knows: reset on GPIO23 rather than GPIO17, and two lines (SX1261, AD5338R) nothing else here has at all. A Pi with this HAT will not answer the generic sx1302_spi profile's probe, and the generic profile will not answer this one's either — pick the one that is actually fitted.
